name: Shuah
title: Abraham's wife from Keturah
summary: Shuah was one of the sons of Abraham and his wife Keturah, whom Abraham took as a wife after Sarah's death. Shuah became the ancestor of a people who bore his name, and his descendants settled in the areas east of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Born as a son of Abraham and Keturah
keyEvents.description: Shuah was born as one of the six sons Abraham had with his wife Keturah after Sarah died.

keyEvents.title: Sent Away from Isaac
keyEvents.description: Abraham gave gifts to the sons of his concubines, including Shuah, and sent them away from his son Isaac toward the east while he was still living.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Shuah is listed among Abraham's sons by Keturah in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.
